## Elbaph

The warrior giants of Elbaph have waited centuries for a crew worth fighting beside, and their great tree towers over everything.

Land on a wild island in the New World and complete the Log Pose missions of a wild island in the New World.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [The Road Poneglyphs](05_new_world.md#q-74c0704c257d8552)

**Tasks**

- Land on a wild island in the New World
- Complete the Log Pose missions of a wild island in the New World

**Rewards**

- Doriki +1,080, Belly +100,000, Haki +10 Busoshoku / +10 Kenbunshoku, +2 Training Points (your style)

<a id="q-59d9f48bf68b4547"></a>

## Laugh Tale

Roger reached the last island and laughed until he cried, because the treasure was not what anyone expected.

Laugh Tale stays hidden until your readings, your own and your crew's, cover all four Road Poneglyphs. Then reach the Doriki cap of 50,000, max out Busoshoku and Kenbunshoku Haki, land on Laugh Tale and step through its dungeon into the End.

**Tasks**

- Hold the readings of all four Road Poneglyphs
- Reach 50,000 Doriki
- Max out Busoshoku and Kenbunshoku Haki
- Land on Laugh Tale
- Enter the End

**Rewards**

- Belly +500,000, +2 Training Points (your style), Golden Box, Legendary Crate

<a id="q-772c1ead386bb50a"></a>

## The One Piece

Whatever waits at the end of the world has been guarded for eight hundred years. It will not hand itself over.

Be in the End, within 256 blocks, when the Ender Dragon falls. Your whole crew can share this one. The server will hear about it.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Laugh Tale](06_final_saga.md#q-59d9f48bf68b4547)

**Tasks**

- Take part in defeating the Ender Dragon

**Rewards**

- Belly +1,000,000, +2 Training Points (your style), Straw Hat, Golden Box
